title: Line sketch: Bubbled Romance in Flight
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A man and woman sit side by side in a sleek, retro-futuristic vehicle, each enclosed in a large transparent bubble helmet. The composition centers the vehicle horizontally, using clean lines and flat color fields typical of mid-century illustration (derived from painting #157).
